description: Proposes rezoning 1401 11th Street West for a six-unit dwelling.
Current zoning allows four-unit dwellings on the Holiday Park site.

chips.text: Municipal Planning Commission did not support administration's denial recommendation.
Residents of the Holiday Park neighborhood.
Administration recommended denying rezoning due to non-alignment with infill policies.
Administration warned approval could set a precedent for other large sites without policy.
69 residents expressed concerns; 6 supported the rezoning application.
Applicant promised to accommodate parking and waste management concerns in design.

description: Rezones 902-938 3rd Avenue North to corridor residential.

chips.text: No public comments received on the application to date.

description: Proposes closing a lane in Varsity View.
Transfers land to Ronald McDonald House.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer questioned large vehicle access for future development.
Families staying at Ronald McDonald House will have improved safety.
